page.layout: One page of text in a single column; in the left margin, marginal references beside the lines (Iud.9, a Thebes, Iud.10); page number at the foot right.

main_text.p: re cum civibus vivere quam præesse fuis, maluit. Depulsa igitur captivitate, quæ septem annos populum continuerat, pax Iud.9. per xl. annos fuit. Sed defuncto Gedeoni, filius ejus Abimelech, ex concubina ortus, fratribus interemptis, pēsimis quibusq; confentientibus, & maxime Sichimorum principibus operā ei navantibus, regnum occupavit. Ifq; difcordiis civilibus exercitus, cum fuos bello premeret Thebes. turrim quandā, in quam fe amiffo ᵃopido fugientes receperat, expugnare aggreffus, dum incautius fubit, faxo a muliere ictus periit, cum triennio imperium tenuisset.

Huic succesfsit Thola, qui duobus & xx, Iud.10. annis regno potitus est. Post hunc Iair fuit, qui cum æque viginti & duos annos principatum obtinuisset, populus, relicto Domino, idolis se mancipavit. Obq; id Israelitæ subacti sunt ab Allophylis & Ammonitis, duoq; de xx. annis sub eorum imperio fuerunt. Quo tempore eis, Dominū invocatibus, divinum scilicet responsum redditum est: Simulacra potius invocarent, se non ultra misericordiam ingratis præstiturum. At illi flentes culpam fateri, & precari veniam, abjectisq; idolis Deū implorarn.

page.notes: Marginal references are partly obscured by the scan edge; "Iud.9." and "Iud.10." read with some doubt. The left-margin reference for the Thebes note ("a Thebes") is faint. The word "ᵃopido" appears as printed (a marginal-style superscript before "opido"); the reading "ᵃopido" is uncertain. Words such as "pēsimis", "Ifq;", "Obq;", "Iair", "faxo" are transcribed as printed and may contain printing errors or unclear letters. The last word "implorarn" is partly cut off at the page foot and reads uncertainly; the signature line "ploran." is at the bottom right. Possible mis-reading in "fubit" and "tenuisset" (printed "tenuisset"). Lower-right corner of the scan is slightly faded.
